content.label: Examiner note - one water is the bill for one ester link
content.body: Esterification is condensation: an H from the alcohol and an OH from the acid leave together as water while the C-O link forms. Count your atoms - the ester's carbons are the acid's carbons then the alcohol's carbons (ethyl ethanoate: 2 + 2). The acid catalyst is NOT used up, and the double arrow matters: it is an equilibrium you can steer by removing water.
